$comment: Origin of the HOLLOW SUN UI kit (decision D34). Generated on Scenario Pro (commercial licence) through the Scenario MCP, trimmed, resized and saved as WebP. Every prompt ended with the shared style from scripts/hollowsun-art.json (style) and asked for an isolated element on a transparent background; no names of artists, games or brands were used.

ui_panel.prompt: Large game UI panel frame of blackened iron with bronze filigree corners, nine-slice, flat dark charcoal centre

ui_panel_header.prompt: Game UI panel header bar of iron and bronze with a small central eclipse sun crest

ui_tooltip_common.prompt: Item tooltip frame with a plain dark iron border and small riveted corners

ui_tooltip_magic.prompt: Item tooltip frame with a dark iron border inlaid with a thin line of cold blue enamel

ui_tooltip_rare.prompt: Item tooltip frame with a dark iron border, aged gold trim and small engraved rune marks

ui_tooltip_unique.prompt: Item tooltip frame with a dark iron border edged in molten ember orange cracks, notched corners

ui_slot.prompt: Square inventory slot of dark carved stone with a thin bronze rim

ui_slot_paperdoll.prompt: Square equipment slot plate of dark stone with an ornate bronze rim and corner studs

ui_button.prompt: Wide menu button plate of dark blackened iron with small bronze end caps

ui_button_hover.prompt: The same button plate with polished caps and a warm ember glow along its edges

ui_orb_frame.prompt: Ornate round frame of blackened iron and bronze for a health globe, empty centre

ui_orb_hp.prompt: Perfectly round disc of swirling deep blood red liquid

ui_orb_cinders.prompt: Perfectly round disc of glowing orange embers, sparks and dark smoke

ui_skill.prompt: Square skill button socket of blackened iron with a bronze bevelled rim, empty window

ui_hudbase.prompt: Long horizontal HUD base plate of blackened iron and bronze with sun and flame engravings at both ends

ui_divider.prompt: Horizontal ornamental divider of thin bronze filigree with a tiny eclipse sun

bg_menu.prompt: Wide game main menu background: a ruined fortress town on a hill under a black eclipsed sun with a burning golden corona, ash falling, dark empty left third
